sloka: धर्मः तु गज नास ऊरु सद्भिर् आचरितः पुरा ।तम् च अहम् अनुवर्ते अद्य यथा सूर्यम् सुवर्चला ॥२-३०-३०॥
transliteration: dharmaḥ tu gaja nāsa ūru sadbhir ācaritaḥ purā ।tam ca aham anuvarte adya yathā sūryam suvarcalā ॥2-30-30॥

translations.english: O one with (shapely) thighs like the trunk of an elephant follow only the path of righteousness practised earlier by the virtuous as Suvarchala follows the Sun.
